metadata.project: thefuck_vuln (thefuck 3.30, source tree of CodeQL db thefuck-db)
notes: Pass 1 (CWE-022/023/036/073 Path Traversal) only; generated from extraction/sources.csv (420 rows) and extraction/sinks.csv (139 rows); every row processed.

Dedup policy: exact duplicate rows within a CSV and nodes matched by both queries collapse into one entry keyed by (file, line, callable); 5 nodes appear in both CSVs and carry a single merged decision (conf.py:17 init, corrector.py:8 get_loaded_rules, entrypoints/shell_logger.py:64 shell_logger, types.py:131 from_path, utils.py:240 _get_mtime).

Trust model: thefuck is a standalone interactive CLI (no web/routing/request surface). Input boundaries are the failed command's script+terminal output, the argparse CLI, the process environment (XDG_*/HISTFILE/THEFUCK_OUTPUT_LOG/TF_HISTORY/...), and tar/zip entry names. Env/CLI values are local-user trust -> classification candidate, not tp. command.output is attacker-influenceable when the failed command displayed attacker content; archive entry names are fully attacker-controlled when a crafted archive is named on the command line.

No sanitizer entries: no base-directory containment, no canonicalize+containment, no explicit '..' rejection, no basename-only extraction exists anywhere before the labeled sinks (see phase1_review.md). MySanitizers.qll must fall back to none().

Path()-construction / join/joinpath/expanduser/stat-only rows are labeled role none per the pass-1 sink contract (actual file read/write/delete/create ops only); CodeQL stdlib summaries already propagate taint through os.path.join/expanduser/Path.
Labeling performed in 8 review batches (S1-S4 sources by family, K1-K4 sinks by family) against the real source tree; per-row audit records are in labels_raw_pass1.json.
